### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
Root (customer's own write): sign the early termination notice.
- Hop 1 — reinstatement. ET hub (early_termination_notice_signature_dfe1746e) "An early termination notice is recorded only once the agreement's status is active." Query: status suspended. Search "suspended ... active": reinstatement_after_suspension_f355cd98 "Recording it returns the agreement to active". Its own condition "Reinstatement is recorded once every invoice past its due date has been paid in full" holds (all past-due invoices settled, balance 0.00). **state-derived**.
- Hop 2 — automatic renewal. ET hub "The early termination fee is fixed only after the agreement carries the term in force on the day the notice is signed, its term end date falling on or after that day." Query: term_end 2026-09-30 < 2026-10-08, auto_renew True. Search "term end ... renewal term": automatic_renewal_into_next_term_7b650c5a "At the end of its term, a ClearPath ... agreement whose automatic renewal is on rolls into its renewal term" and its tool replaces term dates. **state-derived**. (Also supported by 1.1: "A requested date after the term end date is a non-renewal, not an early termination" — before the renewal 12-31 lies after the recorded term end.)
- Hop 3 — October monthly fee. ET hub "The early termination fee is not worked out until the ledger carries the monthly fee of every service month begun before the notice is signed." Query: no managed_monthly_fee for 2026-10. Search "monthly fee ... service month": monthly_fee_invoice_for_the_current_month_aeea6a9a. **state-derived**.
- Hop 4 — monthly fee waits on the renewal. Monthly-fee hub "The monthly fee of a service month is fixed only after the agreement's current term covers the first day of that service month, its term end date falling on or after that day." Term end 09-30 < 10-01 -> renewal (hop 2's write). **state-derived**.
Order: renewal -> October monthly fee -> (reinstatement, independent; any point before signing) -> customer signs. The ET fee reads the October fee (basis window) so the fee must be computed after (b). No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool or a route.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the one thing asked": signing now would record a notice on a suspended agreement (blocked by "recorded only once the agreement's status is active"), fix a fee against an expired term (blocked by the term-in-force sentence; and 12-31 would be after the recorded term end, i.e. a non-renewal per 1.1), and compute the fee with October missing (blocked by the monthly-fee sentence). Excluded by visible sentences + records.
- Closest alternatives: base exit-fee rule instead of the schedule — excluded by scope (one request awaiting signature, 84 >= 60 days). Renewal at base 5 percent cap / list comparison — excluded by the price-protection suspended-during-term tier and the first-renewal tier. Basis from two monthly fees (if (b) skipped) — excluded by hop 3. Floor from contracted 40 (34 seats) — superseded by the renewal's contracted 46.
- Fall-back numbers (baseline documents only, with their named figures): renewal rate 124.00 (lower of 127.60 and 124.00); October fee 124.82 x 46 = 5741.72; reinstatement 250.00; ET fee 60 percent x 124.82 x 40 x 9 = 26961.12. All definite and differ from the blind answers.
- Factor findability (words in the records): suspended_date/status (price protection, re-validation, cure speed), renewal_count 0 / term 24 months (first-renewal uplift), managed_late_fee rows (late-fee history), managed_sla_credit rows (service credits, service failure), ticket opened milestones (ticket volume), seat ledger adds/removals (seat growth, monthly basis), licensing "Microsoft 365 F3"/"Microsoft 365 Business Premium" active (frontline, CSP), backup "Continuum BDR" active (Continuum bundle, Continuum retention), security "Sentinel MDR Advanced" active, term 36, endpoint ledger with device_class server (Sentinel bundle, server fee, monitoring continuity, Sentinel retention), managed_payment rows (relief, cure speed), go_live_date (tenure exit). Each factor doc names the product and record kind; none is pointed to by a computation document.
- Policy-side note (openness, not a document defect): October 2024 service month has only the baseline proration and no monthly fee; "every service month begun" is closed by monthly_seat_fee_terms 3.1 ("The first service month after go-live is billed by the baseline proration charge").
